findings.title: HTTPS is not available
findings.description: The site could not be loaded over HTTPS, so all traffic can be read or modified by anyone on the network path.
findings.recommendation: Serve the site over HTTPS (free certificates are available from Let's Encrypt).
findings.evidence: TLS error: [SSL: WRONG_VERSION_NUMBER] wrong version number (_ssl.c:1035)

findings.title: HTTP does not redirect to HTTPS
findings.description: Visitors who type the address without https:// stay on an unencrypted connection.
findings.recommendation: Answer every plain HTTP request with a 301 redirect to the HTTPS version of the same URL.

findings.title: CSP allows unsafe script sources
findings.description: These sources weaken the policy enough that it may not stop XSS: 'unsafe-inline', 'unsafe-eval', *
findings.recommendation: Replace inline scripts with nonces or hashes and remove 'unsafe-eval' and wildcards from script-src.

findings.title: No clickjacking protection
findings.description: Other sites can embed this page in an invisible frame and trick users into clicking on it (clickjacking).

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff is missing
findings.description: Browsers may guess ('sniff') content types and execute uploaded files as scripts.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy header is missing
findings.description: Full URLs (which may contain tokens or private paths) can leak to other sites through the Referer header.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy header is missing
findings.description: Without it, embedded content may request powerful features such as the camera, microphone or geolocation.
findings.recommendation: Disable what you do not use, e.g. 'Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()'.

findings.title: Deprecated X-XSS-Protection filter is enabled
findings.description: The legacy XSS auditor has been removed from modern browsers and could introduce cross-site leaks in old ones.
findings.recommendation: Send 'X-XSS-Protection: 0' (or drop it) and rely on a strong CSP.

findings.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID': missing HttpOnly, missing SameSite
findings.description: Secure keeps the cookie off plain HTTP, HttpOnly hides it from JavaScript (limiting XSS damage) and SameSite helps against CSRF.

findings.title: Cookie 'tracking': SameSite=None without Secure
findings.description: Secure keeps the cookie off plain HTTP, HttpOnly hides it from JavaScript (limiting XSS damage) and SameSite helps against CSRF.

findings.title: Software versions are disclosed in headers
findings.description: Version banners make it easier to match the server against known vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Hide version numbers (e.g. 'server_tokens off;' in nginx, 'ServerTokens Prod' in Apache, remove X-Powered-By).

findings.title: CORS allows any origin together with credentials
findings.description: This combination is invalid and signals a CORS configuration that may reflect arbitrary origins on other endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Allow-list specific trusted origins instead of '*'.

findings.title: No security.txt file
findings.description: security.txt (RFC 9116) tells researchers how to report vulnerabilities to you responsibly.
